summary: All 6 blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json. The 2 non-blocking improvements are advisory memory only.

items.title: Plugin manifest contract is not defined
items.rationale: The manifest contract is required for deterministic candidate discovery, validation, copying, and registry loading.
items.evidence: spec.json references plugin.json in scope, requirements, and acceptance criteria but does not define required fields or contribution shapes.

items.title: Plugin-owned config validation has no bootstrap path
items.rationale: The config bootstrap order must be explicit because core schema is currently closed and workflow schema moves to a plugin.
items.evidence: spec.json requires workflow config schema/defaults to move to a plugin but lacks validation ordering for plugin-owned config keys.

items.title: Workflow migration cannot identify prior direct users
items.rationale: Existing direct workflow use has no persisted marker, so migration selection must avoid losing the command for prior users.
items.evidence: spec.json says existing workflow users continue after upgrade but does not say which upgraded projects receive the workflow plugin.

items.title: Project-local preset overrides do not preserve plugin preset inheritance
items.rationale: Project-local overrides must inherit from active plugin presets after non-base presets leave src/presets.
items.evidence: spec.json keeps .senti/presets/<key>/ overrides but does not define registry-backed inheritance for plugin-provided preset keys.

items.title: Local path sources conflict with commit-pinned reproducibility
items.target: Repo source and commit pinning semantics
items.rationale: Local path sources must still provide a reproducible commit and clear failure mode.
items.evidence: spec.json supports local paths and commit-pinned plugin.packages but does not define Git/dirty/non-Git handling.

items.title: DataSource static meta is both required and nice-to-have
items.rationale: The user selected static meta as initial scope, so R6 priority must match the required scope.
items.evidence: spec.json includes DataSource static meta in scope, tasks, and acceptance criteria while R6 has priority nice-to-have.
